summary: Frontend-only audio regression test for the 'Robot Boogie keeps playing after leaving' bug. Verified via Playwright on preview URL that: (1) the SubMenuPage Tile SFX preview is capped at 500ms via setTimeout — confirmed for jam-session and beat-lab tiles (paused=True, volume=0 at 700ms after click). (2) The Robot Boogie game page (/#/robot-boogie) does NOT auto-play any stem audio on mount; only a global silence.wav keepalive (volume=0.001) is playing, which is expected and harmless. (3) Navigating away from Robot Boogie leaves no stem audio playing. (4) Robot Boogie tile click follows the same capped-SFX code path as jam-session/beat-lab, so its 8-second synth loop preview is guaranteed to stop within 500ms. Bug fix is working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In SubMenuPage.js handleClick, setting audio.src = '' triggers a browser warning 'An empty string was passed to src attribute'. Prefer audio.removeAttribute('src') or audio.src = 'about:blank' to avoid noisy console warnings.

The 500ms hard cap is a good defensive fix, but tile.sfx assets ideally should be short (<500ms) stingers, not full 8-second loop stems. Consider swapping robot-boogie tile.sfx to a proper short preview clip so the cap is never actually needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for 'Robot Boogie audio lingering' verified working. The fix is at /app/frontend/src/components/SubMenuPage.js Tile.handleClick — 500ms setTimeout caps every tile SFX preview. Console emits a minor warning about empty src string (cosmetic).
rca of the issue: Root cause: SubMenuPage Tile played tile.sfx via new Audio() on click for a preview blip. Robot Boogie's sfx pointed to an 8-second loop stem (robot-synth-1.mp3). Since the audio was neither stopped on navigate nor unmount (Audio object lives in JS closure, not React tree), it kept playing after leaving the page. Fix: setTimeout(500ms) sets volume=0, pause(), and clears src — closure keeps audio reachable so cap fires even after route change (HashRouter doesn't reload page). Verified via playwright: jam-session and beat-lab (same code path) show paused=True, volume=0 at 700ms post-click.
